title: No test covers rollback after a stream was stopped or test-started; the withStream fake hides stream state
test: tests/obsWebSocket.test.js (lane obs, 4eafb14): 'a setup that fails after the encoder-reset test stream ends with OBS not streaming, and its rollback starts no stream (VAL-141)', 'a setup that fails after it stopped a stream stuck retrying a dead room puts the previous service back after the test stream, never the probe or the room (VAL-141)', todo 'a setup that fails after it stopped a stream stuck retrying a dead room leaves OBS not streaming, and the rollback starts nothing' (todo: C-2e1af7e99156); status assertions added to 'configureObsStream restores the previous service after a later validation failure' and 'rejected AV1 encoder candidates roll back to the prior H.264 route'
proof: No test could fail for 'no test exists', so the proof is in the two cases the issue fears. (1) Stale stream: with OBS retrying a room that no longer exists (outputActive and outputReconnecting true) and a setup that fails after the probe test stream, today's rollback ends with OBS streaming. stopActiveStream sends its StopStream through the transaction, so the journal holds a StartStream for it, and the rollback sends it after the previous service is back: the todo test fails on the unchanged code with 'no AV1 encoder is available: the rollback sent StartStream after it restored the previous service' (obs.order ends ..., SetStreamServiceSettings (room), SetStreamServiceSettings (previous), StartStream; status ends outputActive true, outputReconnecting false), and the setup's own message says 'OBS settings were restored'. The code cannot change in this item (src/lib/obsWebSocket.js is out of bounds), so that assertion is a node:test todo naming C-2e1af7e99156 (the plan issue for the rollback of that StopStream; no plan item fixes the restart itself). A three-line prototype in a scratch copy (a stop of a stream that was only retrying goes over the raw channel, not the journal) makes the todo test pass for both failure points and leaves the other 74 tests passing; it was reverted. (2) Idle OBS, setup failing after the probe test stream (no AV1 encoder; or every encoder write refused after a video change, via the new scriptedObs reject map): these pass on today's code and pin the rollback: OBS ends idle, the log ends with the restore of the previous service, the only StartStream is the probe's, and the service writes are probe, room, previous. Mutations of src/lib/obsWebSocket.js, each reverted: (a) the test stream sent through the transaction instead of the housekeeping channel: the two new tests fail, with 7 existing ones (the rollback starts and stops the stream again, so the final state is idle and only the order assertions show it); (b) stopTestStream returning at once without a StopStream: both withStream AV1 tests fail on their new 'outputActive false' assertion (true !== false), with the new tests and 11 existing ones; (c) the room write journaled again after the probe: the two new tests fail, with 6 existing ones.
